[[File:Compound of five small rhombicubes.stl|thumb|3D model of a compound of five small rhombihexahedra]]
This [[uniform polyhedron compound]] is a composition of 5 [[small rhombihexahedron|small rhombihexahedra]], in the same [[vertex arrangement|vertex]] and [[edge arrangement]] as the [[compound of five small rhombicuboctahedra|compound of 5 small rhombicuboctahedra]].
